A '''senatorial rank badge''' was worn by [[Senator/Legends|senators]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] to signify their title in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]]. It consisted of a small, rectangular plaque fitted with three [[Color/Legends|red]] pips arranged horizontally.<ref name="TCW Visual Guide" /> During the [[Battle of the Kaliida Nebula/Legends|Battle]] of the [[Kaliida Nebula/Legends|Kaliida Nebula]], Senator [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] wore one such badge on the left of her waistcoat.<ref name="Destroy Malevolence">{{TCW|Destroy Malevolence|Destroy ''Malevolence''}}</ref>
